mapper.select:
SELECT A.CENTER_ID, A.CENTER_NM, A.CENTER_STARTTIME, A.CENTER_ENDTIME, CASE WHEN ( ( SELECT COUNT(B.BROD_CODE) FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE B WHERE B.BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} AND A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID ) > 0 ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BROD_CODE FROM TB_CENTERINFO A WHERE CENTER_USEYN = 'Y' AND CENTER_GUBUN = 'BRANCH01'
AND A.CENTER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY CENTER_NM ASC
SELECT BROD_CODE, CENTER_ID, BROD_DAY, CREATE_CHECK, SCHEDULE_SEQ FROM TB_BRODCENTERSCH WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON B.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID WHERE 1=1
AND C.CENTER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.BROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND B.CREATE_CHECK = #{createCheck}
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_BRODCENTERSCH WHERE CENTER_ID = #{centerId}

SELECT CONCAT(A.SCHEDULE_SEQ, '/', #{brodDay}) FROM TB_BRODCENTERSCH A JOIN TB_CENTERANNIVERSARY B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.CENTER_ID = #{centerId} AND #{brodDay} BETWEEN B.CENTER_ANNISTARTDAY AND B.CENTER_ANNIENDDAY LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON B.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO D ON C.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID WHERE TRIM(D.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(D.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} AND B.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' AND B.DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N'

SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, C.CENTER_STARTTIME AS centerStartTime, C.CENTER_ENDTIME AS centerEndTime, SUBSTRING(E.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN E.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours, E.STRE_FILE_NM AS streFileNm, C.CENTER_ID AS centerId FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON B.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO D ON C.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL E ON A.BASIC_FILE_ID = E.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE TRIM(D.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(D.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} AND B.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' AND B.DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, C.CENTER_STARTTIME AS centerStartTime, C.CENTER_ENDTIME AS centerEndTime, SUBSTRING(E.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN E.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours, E.STRE_FILE_NM AS streFileNm, C.CENTER_ID AS centerId FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON B.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO D ON C.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL E ON A.BASIC_FILE_ID = E.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE TRIM(D.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(D.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} AND B.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' ORDER BY B.SCHEDULE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, C.CENTER_STARTTIME AS centerStartTime, C.CENTER_ENDTIME AS centerEndTime, C.CENTER_ID AS centerId FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON B.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO D ON C.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID WHERE TRIM(D.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(D.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} AND B.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' AND B.DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N'

SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, C.CENTER_STARTTIME AS centerStartTime, C.CENTER_ENDTIME AS centerEndTime, C.CENTER_ID AS centerId FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON B.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO D ON C.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID WHERE TRIM(D.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(D.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} AND B.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' ORDER BY B.SCHEDULE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BRODCENTERSCH ( SCHEDULE_SEQ, BROD_CODE, CENTER_ID, BROD_DAY, CREATE_CHECK, CREATE_REGDATE ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('schedule_seq'), #{brodCode}, #{centerId}, #{brodDay}, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BRODCENTERSCH SET CREATE_CHECK = #{createCheck}, CREATE_REGDATE = NOW() WHERE SCHEDULE_SEQ = #{scheduleSeq}::numeric
UPDATE TB_BRODCENTERSCH SET CREATE_CHECK = #{createCheck}, CREATE_REGDATE = NOW(), DID_DOWNCHECK = #{didDownCheck}, DID_DOWNLOADDATE = NOW() WHERE SCHEDULE_SEQ = #{scheduleSeq}::numeric
UPDATE TB_BRODCENTERSCH SET CREATE_CHECK = #{createCheck}, CREATE_REGDATE = NOW(), DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N', DID_DOWNLOADDATE = NULL WHERE SCHEDULE_SEQ = #{scheduleSeq}::numeric
UPDATE TB_BRODCENTERSCH SET CREATE_CHECK = #{createCheck}, CREATE_REGDATE = NOW(), DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N', DID_DOWNLOADDATE = NULL WHERE CENTER_ID = #{centerId} AND BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
UPDATE TB_BRODCENTERSCH SET CREATE_CHECK = 'Y', CREATE_REGDATE = NOW(), DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N', DID_DOWNLOADDATE = NULL WHERE CENTER_ID = #{centerId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_BRODCENTERSCH WHERE BROD_CODE IN ( SELECT BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} OR BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
